contract.atomicFactSet: Libra在完整冻结页集的全部正式Match Work成功后，重验各页Result/输入/模型/阈值/最高分并冻结有界UsAdultMatchCompletion；只写Libra不可变完成事实，Basis、来源Run与全部页数必须相等；重复返回原完成事实，任何缺页不能形成未识别结果；不写People、Arca、Event、Effect或Outbox
contract.rollbackInvariant: Any participant, revision fence, digest, or CAS failure leaves zero transaction writes visible; no commit marker, receipt, or outbox may survive alone.

crashFixtures.faultInjectionPoints: exact Run/Basis and full durable Match Result validation, completion row, before and after COMMIT
crashFixtures.requiredInvariant: Completion is immutable and all-or-none; absent or failed pages never become an unmatched decision; no cross-Owner or execution writes
